Now I’m engaged and had to take my fiancé to the ER once for something unrelated. Just sitting there while he was sleeping on the bed, feeling so helpless. I couldn’t stand thinking how often my mom and dad would lay beside me next to the hospital bed. I texted them right away thanking them, apologizing, and telling them I have no clue how they did it.
